status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned
runnerInput: persisted speed-enriched strict-OOS runner features/probabilities from run 31244347590
ticketFeatures: active-runner speed-enriched feature vector for win; for pairs per-feature mean and absolute difference; JRA official ticket odds; normalized JRA ticket market probability; strict-OOS normal/residual Plackett-Luce combination probabilities and model/market ratios; race context inherited from runner features
experts: market-only plus each family x fixed shrinkage; no experts added after evaluation
correctedProbability: for residual families clip(marketP + shrinkage*predictedResidual,1e-8,1) then renormalize to probability mass 1 for win/quinella and 3 for wide; realizedValue expert uses ticket utility shrinkage*predictedValue directly combined with market expected value
ticketUtility: corrected_probability * official_odds - 1 for residual families; (1-shrinkage)*(marketP*odds-1)+shrinkage*predictedValue for realizedValue family

expertChoice.metric: Bayesian-shrunk realized return of top 10 tickets on strictly prior race dates only

raceSelection.score: mean across required bet types of mean top3 positive ticket utilities multiplied by prior-date shrunk expert return; if utilities are nonpositive use their raw ordered values

allocation: mandatory 100 yen on top utility ticket of each required bet type; allocate remaining 100-yen units by ticket utility times prior-date shrunk expert return; maximum 200 yen per ticket; if all utility nonpositive continue in descending utility until exact budget spent
